Lists

Unordered lists use a single asterisk marker:

  • a first item
  • a second item, with code and bold inside
  • a third item that soft-wraps onto another line, since prose does not always fit

Ordered lists use a single period:

  1. step one
  2. step two

Items may be separated by blank lines and still form one list:

  • separated
  • but together

Checklists mark individual items:

  • something finished
  • something outstanding
  • an ordinary item in the same list

A backslash keeps the bracket literal, since that position is where checklist syntax is recognized:

  • [ ] not a checkbox
